newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes slightly lower at 993.54.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes slightly lower at 993.54.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 0.34 centavos lower at 993.54 in quiet trading on the country's interbank market.
Dealers reported some dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters but said suspected dollar-buying by the central bank late in the session checked the peso's potential gains.

The bank, which is under pressure from the government and exporters to weaken the peso, had warned that it would intervene by buying dollars if the local currency hit the top of its daily floating rate exchange band, which was set for the day at 993.50.
Dealers reported 120 trades for a total of $70.9 million and said the peso held in an unusually narrow 993.90 to 993.40 range throughout the day.
